lines.en: The city mouse and the country mouse
lines.zh: 城市老鼠和乡下老鼠

lines.en: This is a city mouse.
lines.zh: 这是一只城市老鼠。

lines.en: He lives in a big city with tall buildings and lots of shops and restaurants.
lines.zh: 他住在大城市里，那里有高楼大厦，还有许许多多的商店和餐馆。

lines.en: But today he is visiting his friend, a country mouse.
lines.zh: 不过今天，他去看望他的朋友——一只乡下老鼠。

lines.en: The country mouse lives in a cozy nest at the bottom of a tree.
lines.zh: 乡下老鼠住在树根下一个舒服的小窝里。

lines.en: Her home is small, but it is warm and comfortable.
lines.zh: 她的家很小，却温暖又舒服。

lines.en: The country mouse cooks a dinner of food from her garden: corn, carrots, acorns and a cold glass of water from the stream Meanwhile, the city mouse talks and talks: The city is amazing!
lines.zh: 乡下老鼠用自家菜园里的东西做了一顿晚饭：玉米、胡萝卜、橡子，还有一杯从溪里打来的凉水。这期间城市老鼠说个不停：城里可棒了！

lines.en: I go to the theater and the museum...
lines.zh: 我去看戏、逛博物馆……

lines.en: My house has TWENTY rooms.
lines.zh: 我家有二十个房间。

lines.en: You absolutely MUST visit!
lines.zh: 你一定得来看看！

lines.en: Have you ever tried Chinese food?
lines.zh: 你吃过中国菜吗？

lines.en: That night, the country mouse dreams that she lives in the city.
lines.zh: 那天晚上，乡下老鼠梦见自己住在了城里。

lines.en: She dreams that she eats at fancy restaurants, says fancy things, and buys fancy hats from fancy stores.
lines.zh: 她梦见自己在高级餐厅吃饭，说着讲究的话，在讲究的店里买讲究的帽子。

lines.en: She dreams about eating Chinese food.
lines.zh: 她梦见自己在吃中国菜。

lines.en: "How wonderful!"
lines.zh: “多棒啊！”

lines.en: she thinks.
lines.zh: 她心想。

lines.en: "I want to live in the city too!"
lines.zh: “我也想住在城里！”

lines.en: The next morning the country mouse agrees to visit the city mouse.
lines.zh: 第二天早上，乡下老鼠答应去城里做客。

lines.en: She packs her bag and follows the city mouse back to his big house in the city.
lines.zh: 她收拾好包，跟着城市老鼠回到他在城里的大房子。

lines.en: The house is enormous!
lines.zh: 这房子大极了！

lines.en: There are TWENTY rooms full of beautiful furniture.
lines.zh: 有二十个房间，里面摆满了漂亮的家具。

lines.en: The country mouse is amazed.
lines.zh: 乡下老鼠看得目瞪口呆。

lines.en: "Which room is mine?"
lines.zh: “哪一间是我的呢？”

lines.en: she asks.
lines.zh: 她问。

lines.en: we actually live down here…" says the city mouse.
lines.zh: 其实我们是住在下面……”城市老鼠说。

lines.en: He leads her down some stairs to the basement.
lines.zh: 他带她走下几级楼梯，来到地下室。

lines.en: In the darkness, the country mouse sees many families of mice.
lines.zh: 黑暗中，乡下老鼠看见好多窝老鼠。

lines.en: "These are my housemates…" explains the city mouse.
lines.zh: “这些是我的室友……”城市老鼠解释道。

lines.en: The city mouse leads the country mouse back upstairs for dinner.
lines.zh: 城市老鼠带乡下老鼠回到楼上吃晚饭。

lines.en: In the dining room there is a feast of delicious foods on the table: cheese, bread, cookies, cakes, and lemonade.
lines.zh: 餐厅的桌子上摆满了好吃的：奶酪、面包、曲奇、蛋糕，还有柠檬水。

lines.en: There is also… Chinese food!
lines.zh: 还有……中国菜！

lines.en: But just as they start to eat...
lines.zh: 可他们刚要开吃……

lines.en: CRASH!
lines.zh: 哐当！

lines.en: A cat with sharp teeth and sharp claws jumps up on the table.
lines.zh: 一只牙齿锋利、爪子尖尖的猫跳上了桌子。

lines.en: REEEEEOWWWW!
lines.zh: 喵——呜！

lines.en: The city cat chases the two mice off the table and across the floor.
lines.zh: 城里的猫追着两只老鼠跳下桌子、穿过地板。

lines.en: The mice hide in a hole in the wall.
lines.zh: 两只老鼠躲进了墙上的一个洞里。

lines.en: They are trapped!
lines.zh: 他们被困住了！

lines.en: They wait silently until the cat leaves.
lines.zh: 他们静静地等着，直到猫离开。

lines.en: Then, they quietly creep back to the dining room … but all the food is gone!
lines.zh: 然后他们悄悄摸回餐厅……可所有吃的东西都没了！

lines.en: The city humans ate everything!
lines.zh: 城里的人把东西全吃光了！

lines.en: The country mouse hurries back to the basement and packs her bag.
lines.zh: 乡下老鼠急忙跑回地下室，收拾好她的包。

lines.en: "Where are you going?"
lines.zh: “你要去哪儿？”

lines.en: asks the city mouse.
lines.zh: 城市老鼠问。

lines.en: "Home.
lines.zh: “回家。

lines.en: ” she says.
lines.zh: ”她说。

lines.en: I want to go back to the country.
lines.zh: 我要回乡下去。你的城市生活其实也没那么好。现在，麻烦你帮我叫辆出租车吧。

lines.en: Your city life isn't so wonderful after all.
lines.zh: 你的城市生活其实也没那么好。

lines.en: Now, please, help me call a taxi.
lines.zh: 现在，麻烦你帮我叫辆出租车吧。

lines.en: Moral: Sometimes other people’s lives are not as great as they make you believe.
lines.zh: 寓意：别人的生活，有时候并不像他们说得那么好。
